title: 09/22/17 - Software Updates
content:
## 09/22/17 - Software Updates


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000035599

We made updates to several Default Widgets this week. If you have customized any of these widgets and would like to update your customized widget, you can find the latest code in the corresponding Default Widget. Please remember that if you have a custom version of any of these widgets, our latest updates have not been pushed to your website.


## Updates:


- The Insta-Load Search Results Add-On is now available.

- The Verify Listing Section in the Member Dashboard is now based on text labels. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Verify Listing

- The "Deleted" word when a Member deletes Posts is now a text label. Also, the footer text of the Review Tab on the Member Profile Page is now based on text labels.

- We added a new Advanced Setting called quote_live_links in order to support links on the Quote Section on the Member Profile Page. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Member Profile - Overview Tab

- We fixed an issue that was affecting the Photo/Logo Resizer.

- The Events Forms and the Recurring Events information on the Events Form is now based on text labels.

- We fixed an issue that was affecting the Click-To-Call Members Add-On when the Insta-Load Search Results Add-On was activated on a site.
